messages.text: Receiving and quality teams needs one defensible decision for relay shipment against PO-0036 by 2026-01-13; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside PO line, receipt organization, lot, certificate, and dock count must reconcile.
I found 112 EA on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0036 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000036 up to 105 EA, provided PO line, receipt organization, lot, certificate, and dock count must reconcile. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or reject_entire_shipment.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for inspection capacity before put-away is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R8 and the CASE-037 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-036.

Required closeout records: send the scoped completion reply in the existing email thread; and record the selected option, committed completion, and binding constraint in the existing Control outcome cell. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
